reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing skill-management tool for DeepSeek Harness that runs inside DSH settings to maintain `~/.dsh/skills`, import skill directories in batch, and normalize skill metadata for `/name` invocation. Its core behavior is filesystem-based skill administration with optional AI-assisted naming, exposed through local RPC/UI integration.

summaries.zh: lt-lt-dsh-skill-manager 是一款 DSH 技能管理插件，在设置页面集中管理 `~/.dsh/skills` 中的技能目录，支持批量导入并可利用已配置模型标准化技能名称以用于 `/name` 调用。
summaries.en: lt-lt-dsh-skill-manager is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages skills under `~/.dsh/skills` from the settings page, supports batch directory import, and can use a configured model to normalize names for `/name` use.

capabilities: Lists and manages skills stored under the user’s configured DSH skills directory.
Imports multiple local skill directories and updates skill metadata after validation.
Optionally calls a configured AI model to parse/normalize skill names and descriptions.
Renames skill directories and rewrites frontmatter to keep name/description synchronized.
Exposes plugin RPC endpoints used by client and local web UI for listing/import operations.

reasons.code: README describes local file system management of `~/.dsh/skills`, including listing, importing, renaming, and frontmatter updates for skill directories.
README states the plugin can invoke a selected harness AI model during import to parse skill names/descriptions, indicating external model/network usage.
Package metadata includes a web client/UI injection and DSH bundle patch for plugin operation, and scripts/API references show a runnable plugin interface.
